title: Distance and displacement (দূরত্ব ও সরণ)
placement: Book page 39, topic 2.4: দূরত্ব ও সরণ. Next to চিত্র ২.০৪ (the winding road), or in place of it.
description: Interactive 3D countryside with the winding road of the book's Figure 2.04 (page 39, topic 2.4), kilometre posts 0-7, the points A, B, C, a compass and a 1 km scale bar. The student drags a cyclist along the road (or taps the road, or rides to B, to C, back to A). A blue trail shows the distance travelled (দূরত্ব, a scalar: out on one side of the road, back on the other, a second stripe for a second pass) and a straight orange arrow from A shows the displacement (সরণ, a vector: size and direction); each has its value beside it on the map. The panel reads both and splits the distance into its legs: at B 4 km against 2 km north-east; at C 6 km against 1.31 km; back at A 6 + 6 = 12 km while the displacement is zero. The road and distances are to scale (the same road as the speed figure on page 41); houses, trees and the cyclist are drawn bigger than real. Test tab: 5 questions (how to state a displacement, its direction versus the way the cycle rides, the distance of an out-and-back ride, the displacement after a round trip, displacement never more than distance). Phone-first, Bangla.
